useWhen: Creating sales collateral for the team
Preparing pitch decks and demo scripts
Setting up sales team for success with proper materials

workflow.description: Assess what sales needs, understand sales process, gather common prospect questions
Create pitch deck, battlecards, demo script, and FAQ tailored to product
Research competitive comparisons, develop objection responses, identify win themes

examples.input: Create sales enablement materials for a B2B SaaS product
examples.output: Complete sales kit with pitch deck, battlecards for top 3 competitors, demo script, and FAQ
examples.context: New product launch needing sales team prepared

examples.output: Updated battlecards with current competitor analysis, objection responses, and win themes
